rationale: EO 11728 (July 12, 1973) amended section 104(b)(1) of EO 11157 (incentive pay for hazardous duty involving aerial flight) to require 2 hours of aerial flight in a calendar month, with carry-over of hours flown in the preceding five months. Under the strike-and-insert ruling of 2026-10-21 an amendment continues, amended, until the parent order ends. EO 11157 of June 22, 1964, as amended, was revoked by EO 13294 of March 28, 2003 (Sec. 2), which also delegates the underlying statutory authority (37 U.S.C. 301, 301a and 301c) to the Secretaries. The status is NO: the parent order carrying the amended section 104(b)(1) was revoked on March 28, 2003.
